Rename the `UserID` type to `AccountID` throughout this Go module. Update
every reference — the type definition, struct fields, function parameters,
map key types, call sites, and the test. Nothing else should change; the
module must still build and its tests must still pass.

.git/
go.mod
store.go
types.go
user.go
user_test.go
validate.go

Renamed `UserID` → `AccountID` in all five files (type definition, `User.ID` field, `NewUser`/`Get`/`ValidID` parameters, map key types, and the test's call sites). `go build ./...` succeeds, `go test ./...` passes, and no `UserID` references remain.
